environment/instructions/integration.md:13: The public instruction mandates Express, better-sqlite3, Node built-ins and SQLite, while browser-only judging cannot establish those implementation technologies.
quality.counterexample: A browser-observable server-backed playground built with Node built-ins and a different persistent storage engine can satisfy every current browser criterion while violating the public Express/better-sqlite3/SQLite mandate. Conversely, a working Express/SQLite app receives no distinct credit for satisfying that mandate.
quality.suggested_fix: Remove the task-added Express/better-sqlite3/SQLite implementation mandate or provide an authorized, feasible check of it without changing the shared browser-only judge policy.
